creator.settings.keyReplace: Paste a new key to replace it

creator.settings.proxyRestHelp: New sign-ups leave it out for this long.
creator.proxies.helpBody: The proxies sign-ups run through, kept apart from Shard’s own list. IP type is found from each test’s exit IP; a proxy that fails sign-ups in a row rests.
creator.proxies.emptyHint: Add proxies so new emails get a browser to sign up through.
creator.proxy.foundBy.ip-api: A lookup of the exit IP
creator.setup.eleWhy: New accounts need Ele to make temp mailboxes and read their codes.
creator.setup.proxiesWhy: New emails need a proxy for their browser, or go without one when making accounts.
creator.make.block.NO_ELE_KEY: Set up Ele mail in Settings first
creator.make.block.NO_PROXY: No working proxy. Add proxies, or make them without one
creator.make.block.NO_CAPTCHA_KEY: Email sign-ups here need a YesCaptcha key in Settings
creator.confirm.deleteEmailsBody: Their accounts, browsers and saved mail go with them.
creator.confirm.deleteProxiesBody: Their browsers move to a working proxy first. If none is left, nothing is deleted.
creator.emailPeek.gone.outlook: Microsoft refused this mailbox’s sign-in token (revoked, password changed or locked). No mail can be read.
creator.emailPeek.gone.ele: Ele deleted this inbox. No new mail can arrive.
creator.error.INTERRUPTED: The run stopped: the window closed, all browsers were closed, or the app quit.
creator.error.QUIT_AFTER_OTP: The app quit after Google took the code. The Google account may exist.
creator.error.WINDOW_CLOSED: The sign-up tab or pop-up closed during a step.
creator.error.PROXY_UNUSABLE: The browser’s proxy is off, failing, resting or deleted. Change its proxy.
creator.error.NO_PROXY: No working proxy was free for a new browser.
creator.error.PROXY_REFUSED: The proxy refused the connection or asked for a sign-in.
creator.error.PAGE_LOAD_FAILED: The site’s page didn’t load (a network error through the proxy).
creator.error.GEO_BLOCKED: The site blocks the proxy’s country or IP.
creator.error.PROXY_CHECK_FAILED: The browser couldn’t use the proxy (refused, or its location lookup failed).
creator.error.CAPTCHA_RATE_LIMITED: The captcha service limits this IP. Try another proxy later.
creator.error.CAPTCHA_EXTENSION: The YesCaptcha extension couldn’t be prepared.
creator.error.NO_CAPTCHA_KEY: Add the YesCaptcha key in Settings.
creator.error.MAILBOX_GONE: The mail provider deleted this inbox. Make a new account.
creator.error.MAIL_API_DOWN: The mail service (Ele or Outlook) didn’t answer.
creator.error.NO_MAIL: The code or verification mail never arrived.
creator.error.CODE_NOT_SENT: The site wouldn’t send the code (it usually works on a later try).
creator.error.CODE_REJECTED: The site didn’t accept the code.
creator.error.VERIFY_LINK_FAILED: The verification link didn’t finish the sign-up.
creator.error.EMAIL_REFUSED: This site doesn’t accept this email address. Other services may.
creator.error.GOOGLE_REFUSED: Google refused the sign-up (usually the proxy IP).
creator.error.AGE_STEP_FAILED: The age step didn’t go through.
creator.error.SIGNUP_NOT_COMPLETED: The sign-up form was sent, but the site didn’t finish it.
creator.error.NOT_SIGNED_IN: The account didn’t end up signed in.
creator.error.API_KEY_FAILED: The API key wasn’t made or didn’t pass its test.
creator.error.NO_CHAT_REPLY: The chat check got no reply.
creator.error.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: An account already exists for this email (not ours).
creator.error.ACCOUNT_BANNED: The site banned or deactivated this account.
creator.error.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: The site says this email isn’t verified.
creator.error.GOOGLE_SIGNED_OUT: Google is signed out in this browser. Log in again from its email first.
creator.error.PARENT_FAILED: The Google account this one signs in with failed.
creator.error.SESSION_NOT_KEPT: Signed in, but not after the browser reopened.
creator.error.CONSOLE_CHECK: Google signed up, but its console check didn’t say active.
creator.error.PAGE_CHANGED: A button or field didn’t show or respond. The site may have changed.
creator.error.STEP_FAILED: A page step failed (often a timeout).
creator.error.APP_ERROR: Something went wrong inside the app. Send the log.
creator.error.PROFILE_RUNNING: The browser was still running. Retry once it’s closed.
creator.error.NO_BROWSER: The email has no browser folder or address.
creator.error.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The browser engine wasn’t ready (still downloading or updating).
creator.error.SIGNUP_FAILED: The sign-up failed without a named reason.
creator.error.OTHER: Not in the error list yet. The backend’s text is shown.
creator.confirm.closeAllBody: Runs in progress stop and can be retried.
creator.settings.relayHelp: Where pushed logins go (Qwen, ChatGPT, Grok and ElevenLabs).
creator.settings.relayKeyHelp: Saved on this computer and never shown again.
creator.settings.relayTestHelp: Asks the relay to accept the saved admin key.
creator.settings.relayFailed: The relay refused or didn’t answer
creator.settings.deleteFailed: Delete the browser of a failed sign-up
creator.settings.deleteFailedHelp: Turn off to keep it for a look.
creator.settings.blockedHelp: New Ele emails on these domains are skipped.
creator.confirm.unfreezeBody: It’s on the relay. Using it here may sign out the relay’s copy.

creator.changeProxy.note: One browser per email: its accounts move together. Open browsers switch when they close.
creator.export.doneLogins: Exported {n} logins to your downloads folder. {skipped} skipped: not ready
creator.export.doneCookies: Exported {n} cookie files to your downloads folder. {skipped} skipped: no cookies yet
creator.export.doneKeys: Exported {n} API keys to your downloads folder. {skipped} skipped: no tested key
creator.make.block.ENGINE_BUSY: The browser engine is updating. Make accounts once it’s done
creator.job.engineWait: Waiting for the browser engine update; it goes on by itself.
creator.proxies.failingWhy: Sign-ups on it fail with a proxy error. Retest it, or change the proxy of its accounts.
creator.make.newMailbox: A new mailbox for each account
creator.settings.importHelp: Copies proxies, blocked domains and the Ele settings from a backup copy. The file isn’t changed.
